questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Typer af kurser og dejlig by.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Man var aldrig "alene", information blev konstant "leveret"

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Uni Heidelberg havde arrangeret introdage med information om uni, det specifikke institut man var på, byen, studieliv, kulturelle tilbud og generelt ryste-sammen-aktiviteter.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Uni Heidelberg havde sendt en liste med forskellige kollegier. Jeg skrev ansøgninger til nogle evangeliske kollegier og fik plads på en af dem. Skrivning af ansøgninger var omstændigt. Jeg blev også tilbudt et kollegieværelse gennem uni (Studierendewerk), men takkede nej, da jeg allerede havde fået det andet tilbudt. På det kollegie jeg boede, boede nærmest udelukkende tyskere og på den måde fik jeg øvet mig godt.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer:
Man skal bruge tid på at skrive ansøgninger, hvis man selv vil finde et kollegie. Ellers er
wggesucht.de
også en mulighed til at finde kollektiver. Prisen er bare højere end på et kollegie.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man fik altid en "to-do-liste" fra Uni Heidelberg og derfor var det hele til at finde ud af. Man skulle gennem en tysk Krankenkasse vise at man har det blå EU-sygesikringskort. Man skulle ned og hente sit studiekort. Alt var skrevet ned som "to-do-liste" og hvis man var i tvivl, kunne man skrive og fik altid hurtigt svar.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Mails. Og et kontor i Altstadt, hvor man kunne møde fysisk op.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Fik alle de kurser, jeg ville have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hvis du bare følger to-do-listerne, skal alt gå. Ellers skriv en mail

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Godt niveau, spændende kurser, engagerede og inspirerende undervisere

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde seminarer (undervisning med dialog) og to forelæsninger (ja, som en forelæsning). I Tyskland har man dog 90 minutter ad gangen og ingen pause

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Grundlagen Spracherwerb, Einführung in die Fremdsprachendidaktik, Einführung in die Psycholinguistik, Einführung in Deutsch als Fremdsprache, Textkomtpetenz B, Latein für Germanisten

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik rigtigt meget ud af "Textkompetenz B", som var for studerende med tysk som fremmedsprog. Kurset hjalp mig til at blive bedre til at skrive på tysk. Derudover var jeg rigtigt glad for Einführung in die Fremdsprachendidaktik, Einführung in Deutsch als Fremdsprache (fantastisk forelæser) og Grundlagen Spracherwerb.

Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ikke nogen

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Fødevarer billigere. Øl i byen billigere. Mensa (kantine) billig (2,9 eur = 22 dkk), når man tager "Power Meal"

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ligesom at vi har studenteridræt, tilbyder Uni Heidelberg "Hochschulsport" til rigtig gode priser. Gratis for studerende at komme i teatret (hvis der var pladser).

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hochschulsport

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Skoven om Heidelberg. Heiligenberg. Næsten hver dag er der "Wochenmarkt" (udendørs) hvor man købe lidt ind (lidt dyrt), super hyggeligt

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: For mig var det nemt, da jeg taler tysk og kom i kontakt med tyskere - jeg kom ud af den "internationale boble".

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Tal med folk, når du sætter dig ind i et undervisningslokale. Sig hej og hvad du hedder og så kører det

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ingen udfordringer ift. kulturelle forskelle - man gør sig observationer og ser hvilke forskelle der er. Man er typisk Des med underviserne og på efternavn (få tilfælde dus)

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Jeg kan godt lide distancen og respekten, når man er Des

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Fed studieby og super skønt uni, glæd dig!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tag det roligt mht. tilmelding af fag. Deadlines for tilmelding er efter at forelæsningstiden er begyndt og du kan derfor gå til nogle forelæsninger/seminarer og se, hvad du kan lide, hvorefter du beslutter dig

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At opleve en anden universitetskultur. Og at alt var på tysk, det har virkelig gjort noget godt for mit sprog.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Nogle gange føler man sig alene og det er helt ok. Du ankommer uden din vennekreds, sandsynligvis med få genstande og i et andet land. Tag det roligt og gør det, som du synes er fedt.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
